surprises.title: Stains appear
surprises.description: Peeling back the carpet reveals a map of every pet accident since 2009.

options.text: Lay the new carpet right over it
Clean and seal the stains with primer
Replace all the subfloor

surprises.title: Subfloor goes soft
surprises.description: Your foot sinks a little near the bathroom door. That's not supposed to happen.

options.text: Replace the subfloor in the whole house
Screw a sheet of plywood on top
Cut out and replace that section

surprises.title: Joist cracks
surprises.description: Under the bad subfloor, a joist has a crack running halfway through it.

options.text: Sister a new joist alongside
Glue the crack shut
Replace every joist in the floor

surprises.title: Floor squeaks
surprises.description: With the carpet up, every step sounds like a haunted house.

options.text: Screw the subfloor down to the joists
Tear out and rebuild the floor
Sprinkle baby powder in the seams

surprises.title: Old tile appears
surprises.description: Under the carpet: 9-inch tiles from the 1960s. Those might contain asbestos.

options.text: Have the whole house abated
Test it and cover it with new flooring
Chip it up with a hammer

surprises.title: Doors drag
surprises.description: The new carpet is plush. Too plush. The doors won't close.

options.text: Leave the doors open forever
Buy all new doors
Trim the bottoms of the doors

surprises.title: Baseboards crack
surprises.description: Pulling the tack strip cracked two baseboards. They cracked louder than your knees.

options.text: Hide the cracks behind furniture
Redo every baseboard, repaint everything
Replace the cracked pieces

surprises.title: Hardwood tempts you
surprises.description: The subfloor is bare. A tiny voice whispers: hardwood would look amazing.

options.text: Paint the subfloor and call it rustic
Switch to hardwood in the whole house
Stick with the carpet plan

surprises.title: Partner requests TV mount
surprises.description: Your partner: "The room is empty anyway. Can you finally mount the TV?"

options.text: Hang it with plain drywall anchors
Mount it after the carpet is in
Build a full media wall with hidden wiring

surprises.title: Odor returns
surprises.description: You sealed the stains, but on hot days the room still smells like 2009.

options.text: Treat with enzyme cleaner and reseal
Spray air freshener under the pad
Replace the subfloor in the whole room

surprises.title: New subfloor sits high
surprises.description: The new plywood is thicker than the old. There's a hump you can trip on.

options.text: Hide it under extra padding
Replace the whole room's subfloor to match
Sand the edges flush

surprises.title: Pipe blocks the sister
surprises.description: A drain pipe runs right where the new sister joist needs to go.

options.text: Move the drain line
Use a shorter sister and add blocking
Cut the pipe to make room

surprises.title: Screw hits a pipe
surprises.description: Pssssst. You just screwed the subfloor down into a water line.

options.text: Repipe the whole house
Shut off the water and splice the pipe
Leave the screw in to plug the hole

surprises.title: Black mastic appears
surprises.description: Under the old tile: thick black glue. That adhesive may contain asbestos too.

options.text: Leave it and cover it with underlayment
Abate the whole floor
Strip it with a heat gun

surprises.title: Door turns out hollow
surprises.description: You trim the door bottom and find... cardboard. It's a hollow-core door.

options.text: Leave it open at the bottom
Replace every door with solid-core
Glue a wood strip back into the bottom

surprises.title: Old paint line shows
surprises.description: The new baseboards are shorter than the old ones. There's a stripe of unpainted wall.

options.text: Repaint every wall in the room
Touch up the wall above the baseboard
Install taller baseboards everywhere

surprises.title: Stairs look worn
surprises.description: The new carpet is gorgeous. The stairs now look like a hiking trail.

options.text: Carpet the stairs and hall too
Flip the stair runner upside down
Add the stairs to the next project

surprises.title: Partner wants new layout
surprises.description: Your partner: "Before the couch goes back, what if we tried it by the window?"

options.text: Drag the couch across the fresh carpet
Buy all new furniture for the new layout
Try it once the carpet is down

ask.question: How do I replace carpet?
ask.answer: Easy! 1. Pull up the old carpet. 2. Roll out the new one. 3. Done!
ask.skipped: It skipped the tack strips and the padding.
